<th class="tl" colspan="1" rowspan="2"><div style="width: 200px;"><strong>Note 7 - Convertible Notes with Warrants (Related Party)<br></strong></div></th>
<th class="th" colspan="1">6 Months Ended</th>
</tr>
<tr><th class="th"><div>Jun. 30, 2026</div></th></tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_DisclosureTextBlockAbstract', window );"><strong>Notes to Financial Statements</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_DebtDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Debt Disclosure [Text Block]</a></td>
<td class="text">
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Note <em style="font: inherit;">7</em> </b>&#8211;<b> Convertible Notes with Warrants (related party)</b> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> December 16, 2022, </em>the Company entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with K.A.H.R. Foundation, a beneficial owner of more than 5% of the Company&#8217;s common stock as of the agreement date (see Note <em style="font: inherit;">12</em>), for the issuance of unsecured, unquoted convertible promissory notes, to be issued in <em style="font: inherit;">two</em> tranches, to raise a maximum aggregate amount of $5,000,000.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> tranche was issued on <em style="font: inherit;"> December 23, 2022. </em>The Company received $2,325,000 in gross proceeds from the issuance of the convertible note. The convertible note bears interest of 10% per annum, compounded annually. The interest accrued during the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">three</em> months ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#160;was $77,152 and $70,139, respectively. The interest accrued during the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#160;was $153,457 and $139,506, respectively. As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>&#160;and&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, cumulative accrued interest on the <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> tranche totaled $929,815 and $776,358, respectively, and the entire principal balance of $2,325,000 remained outstanding at both dates. All or a portion of the principal is convertible into CHESS Depositary Interests (&#8220;CDIs&#8221;, as described further in Note <em style="font: inherit;">9</em>) at a price of $0.2691 per share at the election of the holder following the <em style="font: inherit;">36</em> month anniversary of the closing date. All or a portion of accrued and unpaid interest is convertible into CDIs at a price of $0.2563 per share at the election of the holder during the same time frame. Accrued interest on the convertible notes is included in the fair value of the convertible notes (related party) on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets. The maximum number of CDIs to be issued upon conversion of the principal amount and interest is <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> more than 12,849,949 CDIs. As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>, 12,267,749 CDIs would be issued if the principal and accrued interest were converted.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The <em style="font: inherit;">second</em> tranche was issued on <em style="font: inherit;"> March 28, 2023. </em>The Company received $2,675,000 of gross proceeds from the issuance of the convertible note. The <em style="font: inherit;">second</em> tranche is subject to the same terms as the <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> tranche. The interest accrued during the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">three</em> months ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#160;was $88,767 and $80,697, respectively. The interest accrued during the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#160;was $168,843 and $153,494, respectively. As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>&#160;and&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, cumulative accrued interest on the <em style="font: inherit;">second</em> tranche totaled $977,118 and $808,275, respectively, and the entire principal balance of $2,675,000 remained outstanding at both dates. The maximum number of CDIs to be issued upon conversion of the principal and interest is <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> more than 14,784,350 CDIs. As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>, 13,752,944 CDIs would be issued if the principal and accrued interest were converted.<br/>&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The maturity date on the notes is the earliest occurrence of (i) a change-in-control event, at which time the Company would be required to pay the holder the greater of 125% of the then outstanding balance plus accrued and unpaid interest or the amount the holder would receive if the principal and accrued and unpaid interest had been converted to CDIs at a conversion price equal to the variable weighted average price (&#8220;VWAP&#8221;) of the CDIs for the <em style="font: inherit;">10</em> day period ending on the change-in-control event date; or (ii) the <em style="font: inherit;">four</em> year anniversary of the closing date of each tranche.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> March 28, 2023 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;"> December 23, 2022, </em>pursuant to the Securities Purchase Agreement, the Company issued warrants exercisable for 1,043,699 and 907,141 CDIs, respectively, with an exercise price of $0.2563 per share. The warrants expire <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c149067943">five</span> years after the dates of issuance.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Company accounts for its convertible promissory notes under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815,</em> Derivatives and Hedging ("ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815"</em>). Under <em style="font: inherit;">815</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">15</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">25,</em> the election can be made at the inception of a financial instrument to account for the instrument under the fair value option under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">825.</em> The Company has made such election for its convertible promissory notes because the notes contain conversion and settlement features and management believes that measuring the entire instrument at fair value provides more relevant information about the current value of the obligation and changes in that value over time. Using the fair value option, the convertible promissory notes are required to be recorded at their initial fair value on the date of issuance, and each balance sheet date thereafter. Changes in the estimated fair value of the notes are recognized as a non-cash item in the change in fair value of convertible notes (related party) on the unaudited condensed consolidated statements of operations.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>


   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The convertible notes (related party) were recorded as a liability on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets at the dates of issuance. The following tables provide a summary of change in fair value of the <em style="font: inherit;">two</em> tranches of the convertible notes (related party) for the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> June 30</em>:</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>, the Company had total convertible notes (related party) of&#160;$33,186,900, all of which was classified as current liabilities on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets. As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the Company had total convertible notes (related party) of&#160;$25,014,200&#160;of which&#160;$13,268,500&#160;was classified as long-term liabilities on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets.<br/>&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The fair value of the convertible notes is measured in accordance with ASC <em style="font: inherit;">820</em> using the &#8220;Monte Carlo Method&#8221; modeling incorporating the following inputs:<br/>&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">Significant assumptions used to determine the fair value of the convertible note include the estimated probability of a change in control event, which is based on management&#8217;s expectation of future transactions; the volatility of the stock price, which is estimated based on the Company&#8217;s own historical volatility; and the credit spread, which is based on the Company's estimate of its credit rating derived from the Company's financial condition and market yields for similar instruments issued by companies with comparable credit ratings.<br/>&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Company evaluated the warrants under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">480,</em> Distinguishing Liabilities from Equity (&#8220;ASC <em style="font: inherit;">480&#8221;</em>) and ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815.</em> The warrants do <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> meet the characteristics for liability classification under either provision and as such are classified as equity under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815.</em> Given that the convertible notes were subject to fair value remeasurement, the fair value of the convertible notes was carved out from gross proceeds and the remainder of the gross proceeds of the <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> and <em style="font: inherit;">second</em> tranches of $127,900 and $541,200, respectively, was allocated to warrants. The warrants were recorded as Additional paid-in capital on the unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheets at the dates of issuance. <em style="font: inherit;">No</em> subsequent remeasurement of the warrants is required.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman, Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for information about short-term and long-term debt arrangements, which includes amounts of borrowings under each line of credit, note payable, commercial paper issue, bonds indenture, debenture issue, own-share lending arrangements and any other contractual agreement to repay funds, and about the underlying arrangements, rationale for a classification as long-term, including repayment terms, interest rates, collateral provided, restrictions on use of assets and activities, whether or not in compliance with debt covenants, and other matters important to users of the financial statements, such as the effects of refinancing and noncompliance with debt covenants.</p></div>
